_help: Hand corrections and additions, applied after the automatic sources. Key by site id (the slug in /learn/locations/<slug>). Any field overrides the scraped one; lat/lng need coordPrecision (site | address | street | city). "add": true adds a Church-operated site that has no /learn/locations page. Every entry needs a note and an official source URL.

beehive-house.name: Beehive House
beehive-house.note: Listed on the Historic Sites and Museums page as "Beehive and Lion House"; its link opens the Temple Square page, which gives the address. No /learn/locations page.

taylor-home-print-shop-and-post-office.note: The official page spells the state "Iillinois".

statue-of-alexander-doniphan.name: Statue of Alexander Doniphan
statue-of-alexander-doniphan.note: The Missouri "All Locations" list spells it "Donaphin"; the site's own official page titles it "Statue of Alexander Doniphan".
